budget_note: Models are downloaded on first launch, not bundled. App bundle target <= 700 MB.
language_note: Default ASR is Dolphin base int8: 40 Eastern languages and 22 Chinese dialects, including Minnan (zh-MINNAN) and zh-TW, so 台語 is now attempted rather than declared unsupported. SenseVoice Small remains as the fallback and does NOT support Hokkien.
selection_note: Entries with download:true are fetched on first launch. The rest are offered by the model manager, which writes the chosen LLM filename to UserDefaults and exports it as OVC_LLM_MODEL for the engine.

models.note: Default ASR since 2026-10-25. Measured on the same 5.6 s clip: 0.141 s decode (RTF 0.025), 299 MB peak RSS, 99 MB on disk -- against SenseVoice int8's 0.190 s, 452 MB and 228 MB. CTC decoder, so it stays non-autoregressive and paste latency does not change.
models.summary_zh: 預設辨識模型：40 種語言、22 種中文方言（含閩南語），體積與記憶體都最小。
Dolphin 的字典檔，要跟權重一起存在才能載入。

models.note: Default ASR. On identical test audio the transcript matched the full-precision model, and it is 698 MB smaller, which matters on an 8 GB machine. Now the fallback for installs that predate Dolphin; not downloaded on a fresh install.
models.summary_zh: 上一版預設，現在是備援：找不到 Dolphin 時自動接手。

models.note: Now the fallback for installs that predate Dolphin; not downloaded on a fresh install.
Full-precision fallback, still loaded when model.int8.onnx is absent. Not downloaded by default any more.
models.summary_zh: SenseVoice 全精度版，只在前兩個都缺少時才會載入。

models.note: Default LLM. ChatML like Qwen2.5, but its chat template opens a reasoning block: generation must be prefilled with a closed, empty think block or the model streams its reasoning into the answer (handled in llm.rs from the GGUF chat template).
models.summary_zh: 預設整理模型：品質與記憶體（實測峰值約 1.5 GB）的平衡點。

models.note: Same model at higher precision: ~155 MB more for a little more robustness.
models.summary_zh: 同一個模型的 5-bit 版：檔案更大，品質略好，速度略慢。

models.note: Fastest option, roughly half the size. Expect weaker cleanup on long or messy speech.
models.summary_zh: 最省記憶體，適合邊錄邊整理；會議摘要會比較粗。

models.note: Quality option. Its peak footprint is about 3 GB, which does not fit comfortably next to the ASR model on an 8 GB machine; not recommended there.
models.summary_zh: 品質最好，但記憶體需求明顯更高（這台機器未實測，8 GB 要關掉其他 App）。

models.note: Legacy default, kept as the engine's fallback when the selected model is missing.
models.summary_zh: 舊版模型：回答快，整理品質比 Qwen3.5 差。

models.note: QAT (quantization-aware trained) Q4_0, 265 MiB. Weights are INT4 on purpose: MTEB multilingual mean is 60.62 against Q8_0's 60.93, and this file is the same artifact as the official ggml-org embeddinggemma-300M-qat-q4_0-GGUF. Architecture gemma-embedding, 768-dim, 2048 ctx, MEAN pooling (read from the GGUF metadata). The upstream GGUF omits the Sentence-Transformers dense modules, which is fine here: terms and transcripts are embedded by this same file, so the cosine ranking is self-consistent.
models.summary_zh: 關鍵字檢索與口頭指令篩選用的向量模型（INT4／QAT Q4_0，265 MiB）。它會先把你的關鍵字詞表排序，只把這次真的講到的詞交給整理模型，也會找出「這句話是在叫我刪掉或改掉什麼」的片段。
